[Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{pro
jectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creating an unnamed one
when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Suns
e…\n- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's or
ganization and responds `201` with its detail. Requires organization membership and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit.
Guest callers are denied.\n- [Delete a project and everything scoped to it](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/delete
-a-project-and-everything-scoped-to-it.md): IRREVERSIBLE, and it cascades: project access grants and invites, the mapped workspace
and its memberships, every saved server in the project (each soft-deleted asynchronously, which also rotates the host configs tha
t referenced it), and hosted tasks. Requires project admin. The request body must be…\n- [Update project metadata](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/projects/update-project-metadata.md): Updates name, description, icon or visibility. Requires project admin
; a non-member gets `404` rather than `403`, so the response never confirms that a project exists. The project's server map is not
updatable here. See the per-server routes.\n- [What the caller may do here](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/what-t
he-caller-may-do-here.md): Role, gate state, plan limits and a set of derived booleans, so an agent on a static surface can check
before it acts instead of attempting a write and reading the failure.\n- [Save a server into a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md): Creates a saved MCP server and responds `201` with its detail. This is the p
rovisioning entry point: every eval, host and environment route addresses servers that were created here. Names are unique per wor
kspace, so a clash responds `409` rather than silently returning the existing row. Secret-bear…\n- [List a server's revisions](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A saved server's stored revisions, newest first. A revisi
on is a capture of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever they change on a connect, an eval run or a chat session.
Reads stored data and never connects to the server, so it works for stdio servers too. A server the caller cannot…\n- [Get one ser
ver revision](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-server-revision.md): One stored revision: every tool's definit
ion and the server info the server reported. `droppedFields` lists paths storage dropped for size; their values are unknown, not a
bsent.\n- [Diff two server revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/diff-two-server-revisions.md): Compares `from`
(default: the revision before) with `revisionNumber`: tools added and removed with their definitions, tools changed with the fiel
ds that moved and both definitions, and each changed server info field with both values. Revision 1 has nothing before it, so diff
ing it needs `from`. A fi…\n- [Get one saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-saved-server.md): The s
erver's detail, projected toward the hosted shape. Secrets are never included: `hasClientSecret` reports presence only. A server i
d from another project reads as `404`.\n- [Delete a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/delete-a-saved-ser
ver.md): Soft-deletes the server and schedules its cascade: MCP Apps views, hosted OAuth credentials, encrypted secret objects, an
d a rotation of every host config that referenced it. The cascade is ASYNCHRONOUS, so a read immediately after this call may still
observe the row. The request body must be empty.\n- [Update a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/update-
a-saved-server.md): Sparse update: omitted fields are unchanged. Renaming re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`409` on a clash). E
diting a server shared as an OAuth connection requires project admin. `clientSecret` and `clearClientSecret` are mutually exclusiv
e.\n- [List a project's server groups](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-server-groups.md): A ser
ver group is an immutable snapshot of a set of saved servers. Pinning one on an environment is what keeps a run off its host's liv
e server list, so a composed run keeps testing the servers it was composed against even after the shared host is edited.\n- [Snaps
hot servers into a server group](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/snapshot-servers-into-a-server-group.md): Crea
tes a server group holding exactly the given servers and responds `201` with its detail. Groups are create-only: there is no updat
e route, because an editable group would reintroduce the drift that pinning exists to prevent. Names are unique per project, so a
clash responds `409`. Servers must b…\n- [List a project's environments](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a
-projects-environments.md): The project environments saved in the project. Archived environments are excluded unless `includeArchi
ved=true`: you need that to find one to restore.\n- [Check what this deployment's environment surface supports](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/environments/check-what-this-deployments-environment-surface-supports.md): Report which environment features t
his MCPJam deployment accepts. Call it before sending a model override: clients ship independently of the platform, and a field an
older deployment does not know is a hard validation error there rather than a silently ignored one. A deployment too old to answe
r rep…\n- [Show one environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/show-one-environment.md): Read one environment
, including the `revision` you pass back as `expectedRevision` when writing to it.\n- [Preview what an environment resolves to](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/preview-what-an-environment-resolves-to.md): Resolve an environment to the exact
execution inputs a run would use right now: the host's current config and the closed server set. Returns 409 when the environment
cannot currently produce a runnable configuration; `details.code` carries the specific reason (`ENV_NO_SERVERS`, `ENV_HOST_MISSING
`, ……\n- [Get or create an unnamed environment for a composed stack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/get-or-cre
ate-an-unnamed-environment-for-a-composed-stack.md): GET-OR-CREATE an UNNAMED, content-addressed environment for a composed stack:
a host plus an optional server group and model override. The environment does not appear in the project's list of named environme
nts.\n- [Archive an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/archive-an-environment.md): Archive an environ
ment. It stops being selectable for runs and frees its name for a new one, but the row is kept and can be restored: this is why ar
chive is a sub-action rather than a DELETE. Requires `expectedRevision`: the revision you last read. If the environment changed si
nce, the write is reje…\n- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-projects-scenarios.md
): The studies published from this project: name, access mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.\n- [Publish an environ
ment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.md): PUT, not POST, b
ecause publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publishing an already-published environment returns the existing o
ne rather than minting a second. `created` says which happened.\n- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Unpublishing does not require User Testing access, so an organizatio
n that loses access can still take a live study down.\n- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.m
d): One study's full read: execution settings (model, system prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share link), the envi
ronment it publishes, and the insights envelope over its latest analyzed window.\n- [Update a scenario](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
